topic: Someone finds their college application essay published as an example
text: I was scrolling through the admissions blog, just checking out tips for future applicants, when I stumbled upon an essay. At first, I thought it was a well-crafted piece by some anonymous student, but then I noticed a familiar turn of phrase. It was my essay. Suddenly, all the details clicked into place—the structure, the anecdotes, even the little typo I never got around to fixing. It's flattering, I guess, to be used as an example, but I can't shake the thought that maybe I didn't have as much privacy as I thought. Maybe I should reach out to the admissions office, just to understand how this happened.
